ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.

3. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

5. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

7. A — Producers

8. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

10. B — 100 °C

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

12. C — Ice melting to water
